lines.text: The judge refuses for a while, but later decides to give the widow justice because she keeps threatening him.

problems.problem: Its true detail "because she keeps pestering him" isn't in Luke 18:5 word for word.
Its wrong detail "because he fears God" isn't found anywhere in the Bible.
Its true detail "because she keeps pestering him" isn't in the Prep cards, so the walkthrough didn't teach it.
